description: Configure how to auto-reply to Facebook comments
autoReplyTemplateDesc: You can customize the default reply sent by the manual auto-reply flow.
templateHint: This reply is used when the automatic reply flow is disabled or unavailable.
fixedMessagesDesc: You can specify different replies for the comment and the messenger message.
fixedCommentPlaceholder: Enter the fixed reply that will appear on the comment...
fixedMessengerPlaceholder: Enter the fixed message that will be sent in Messenger...
messengerVariationsDesc: Add several variations for the messages that will be sent in Messenger for variety.
